sn48.70:1.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci supaṇṇānaṃ rukkhā, koṭasimbalī tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn48.70:1.2: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhikā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati, yadidaṃ bodhāya.
sn48.70:1.4: saddhindriyaṃ bhikkhave, bodhipakkhiko dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati …pe… paññindriyaṃ bodhipakkhiko dhammo, taṃ bodhāya saṃvattati.
sn48.70:1.5: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, ye keci supaṇṇānaṃ rukkhā, kūṭasimbalī tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati.
sn48.70:1.6: evameva kho bhikkhave, ye keci bodhipakkhikā dhammā, paññindriyaṃ tesaṃ aggamakkhāyati yadidaṃ
